source.label: On coprime squarefree pairs the type A2 double-series coefficient is the Gauss sum of the product, for cubic symbols

reviewer: Claude Code proof assessment; fresh medium reviewer

claims.summary: In the setting of Chinta and Gunnells, arXiv math/0703040 (F_q[t], q = 1 mod 4n, n-th order residue symbol (x/y), Gauss sums g(r, c), coefficients H(c, d) of the type A2 Weyl group double Dirichlet series defined by prime-power values and twisted multiplicativity): for coprime squarefree monic c1, c2, H(c1, c2) = g(1, c1) g(1, c2) (c1/c2)^-1 = g(1, c1 c2) (c1/c2)^-3. For n = 3 (and n = 1) this is g(1, c1 c2) = H(c1 c2, 1).
claims.assessment: Working elementary proof from the source's displayed definitions (values at primes, twisted multiplicativity, the product rule for Gauss sums), read by a fresh medium reviewer; a remark on definitions, likely known. Function field, untwisted case only. Its relation to the bilinear column sums of the imported half-plane's method is a comparison of forms in the entry, not proved and not part of the claim.
claims.rationale: Identifies, in a model case, the dual columns of a fourth moment of the import's family with the squarefree part of a series that has a group of six functional equations.
claims.next_action: Read the twisted type A2 series over a number field and compute the lengths its functional equations exchange at a twist of given norm.
claims.formalization_scope: Not formalized; no Lean work assigned.

notes.mathematical_status: Complete proof in the entry from definitions read in the source; the source's theorems are cited and not audited.
notes.significance: Context: a remark on a published construction. Novelty not claimed.
notes.relationships: Read against the squared-sum column factorization, whose coefficient rule it matches in form for cubic symbols.

relationships: The entry compares its coefficient rule with that lemma's twisted multiplicativity; a comparison of forms across two settings.
